idea-plugin.name: Fastlane Navigator
idea-plugin.description:
Navigate Fastlane lanes and edit Ruby configuration files directly in Android Studio.

Features

  • Lane navigation: jump between declarations and calls, with platform-aware resolution and Find Usages in the current Fastfile.
  • File structure: browse platforms, public, private, and override lanes, with descriptions from desc.
  • CI navigation: jump to lanes from GitHub Actions and GitLab CI, including Fastlane action inputs and same-file GitLab inheritance.
  • Ruby editing: syntax highlighting and file icons for Fastfile, Pluginfile, Gemfile, Appfile, and other Fastlane configurations.
  • Formatting: use Reformat Code on saved or unsaved files while preserving multiline string contents.

Getting started

Open a Fastfile and use Go to Declaration or Usages on a lane name to navigate between its declaration and calls. Use File Structure to browse lanes and Find Usages to list callers.

To format a file, clear the selection and choose Code → Reformat Code. Ruby is detected automatically; configure its path under Settings → Languages & Frameworks → Fastlane if needed.

Requirements

Android Studio on platform 262.*, with TextMate Bundles and its Ruby bundle enabled. A local Ruby installation is needed only for formatting; the formatter is tested with Ruby 4.0.9 and includes its required gems.

Navigation uses literal lane names. Ruby imports, dynamic names, external CI includes, and arbitrary shell programs are not resolved. The plugin never executes your Fastfile or runs Fastlane.
